scope: Checked CPU uint32 matmul through shared integer matrix/reduction lowering, retained worker results and shared signed/unsigned conformance.

semantics.types: Matching CPU uint32 matrices [M,K] and [K,N] produce an immutable uint32 matrix [M,N], without implicit conversion.
semantics.arithmetic: Each product zero-extends to uint64, checks UINT32_MAX and narrows. All possible uint32 products fit the widened representation. Each cell uses checked unsigned balanced-adjacent sums and an unchanged odd tail.
semantics.overflow: Product, first-pair and later-tree overflow are execution faults in every build. No partial matrix is published even when an earlier output cell succeeded. Original matmul source location is retained.
semantics.shapes: Known inner extent mismatches diagnosed; dynamic dimensions, inner compatibility and byte counts checked before data reads. Empty contraction writes zero-valued cells; empty output avoids contraction work/scratch while metadata bounds remain checked.
semantics.reuse: Existing integer matrix loops, reduction scratch/tree, unsigned integerBinary arithmetic and immutable storage. Runtime, scheduler, continuation planner, task backend and checked ABI unchanged.
semantics.ownership: Borrowed offset/padded/transposed input views remain immutable; aliases supported. Invocation scratch/results settle on success, arithmetic/shape/allocation failure or cancellation. Retained output survives invocation settlement.
semantics.tasks: Nested coordinators/cached awaits use existing typed tensor layouts; retained output survives core and receiving invocation destruction. Product/tree faults are TaskError.Fault/Arithmetic; recovery reuses parent tensors and starts another group.
semantics.remaining: GPU integer arithmetic, additional numeric widths and conversions remain gated. No new public foreign-memory ABI, deadline timer or distributed execution.
